mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription ( prescription_no, patient_name, created_by_user_id, created_by_role, doctor_id, doctor_name, status, doctor_approval_status, doctor_approved_at, pharmacist_operator_id, audit_by, audit_time, dispense_by, dispense_time, reject_reason, remark, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{prescriptionNo}, #{patientName}, #{createdByUserId}, #{createdByRole}, #{doctorId}, #{doctorName}, #{status}, #{doctorApprovalStatus}, #{doctorApprovedAt}, #{pharmacistOperatorId}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{dispenseBy}, #{dispenseTime}, #{rejectReason}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET status = #{status}, doctor_approval_status = #{doctorApprovalStatus}, doctor_approved_at = #{doctorApprovedAt}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, dispense_by = #{dispenseBy}, dispense_time = #{dispenseTime}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, prescription_no, patient_name, created_by_user_id, created_by_role, doctor_id, doctor_name, status, doctor_approval_status, doctor_approved_at, pharmacist_operator_id, audit_by, audit_time, dispense_by, dispense_time, reject_reason, remark, created_by, updated_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM prescription WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
